verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a SaaS web-data API, so exporting a user's own account data in open formats before leaving is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows scrape, crawl and extract results returned as Markdown, HTML or JSON. That is the product's core function on third-party websites, an adjacent capability, not an export of the user's own account data such as monitors, jobs, keys or history. Nothing in the pack documents an account data export or offboarding path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
